description: ALWAYS activate when the user needs to find, organize, review, or synthesize academic literature. Uses academic APIs (Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, CrossRef, arXiv) via scripts/academic_search.py. Handles search strategy, snowballing, screening, concept matrices, narrative synthesis, and literature monitoring (detecting new publications since last search). NEVER use web scraping for paper discovery — APIs first, web search only for verification.
